_comment: Registered Tauri commands that intentionally have NO frontend invoke() caller yet. Each is forward-built backend surface (pending UI, operator/admin tooling, on-chain flow, or test-covered inner fn). check-tauri-commands.mjs fails CI if a NEWLY registered command is missing here AND has no caller, or if an entry here has since gained a caller (remove it then) or no longer exists (remove it then). Shrink this list as UI lands. Value = the gap is tracked, not silent.
import_credential: single-credential import; the UI uses the batch import_credentials, this is the one-shot API
import_credential_from_peer: iroh credential delivery by (endpoint, hash); no UI entry point yet
sign_talent_index_record: signs the record for publication; no index exists to publish to yet (EE Phase 2 Unit 3)
governance_preview_genesis: founding trust-anchor review; import UI pending
tutoring_get_audio_level: tutoring diagnostics; owner kept as pending, not dead
get_goal_template: goal-template detail lookup; detail UI pending (list + resolve are wired)
assessment_start_adaptive: adaptive delivery; turn-by-turn runner UI pending (fixed-form path is wired)
assessment_submit_adaptive_item: adaptive delivery; turn-by-turn runner UI pending
assessment_finalize_adaptive: adaptive delivery; turn-by-turn runner UI pending
get_skill_state_history: confidence decay-curve + velocity data; curve UI pending
